title: Reduced-pair conjecture for nonintegral type-2 zero-problems
statement:
Let $P=(T;U,V)$ be a 3M-DAP, define $r_v=2[s_t-(v-1)s_v]$ and $b^*=2s_v/r_v$, and set

$$
\hat b=\left\lceil\frac{2s_v}{r_v}\right\rceil.
$$

A **$b$-pair** is a maximal inseparable $(T,V)$-pair with $|B|=b$ and $|A|=(v-1)b+1$.

**Reduced-pair conjecture.** If $s_t>(v-1)s_v$ and $b^*=2s_v/r_v$ is not an integer, then there exists an optimal solution in which all maximal inseparable pairs are either $\hat b$-pairs or $(\hat b-1)$-pairs.

This conjecture predicts a two-size structure for maximal inseparable pairs in the nonintegral case. The source gives no resolution in the supplied context.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1907.08726

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of July 2019). “The second conjecture has been proved by Cui et al. (2018) (see Theorem 20 therein).”
source_name: Richard E. Chatwin, “An Optimal Solution for the Muffin Problem”, arXiv:1907.08726 (2020).
